description_expanded: Overview2 Minute Walk to the beach - Community Pool/Seasonally Heated- Bike Rental Option- Public Beach `Beachin` it with the Browns`The SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Steps to the Beach – Easy access to the sugar-white sands! 6 Amenity Bands – Enjoy all the resort-style perks! Tennis Courts – Challenge friends & family to a match! Two Community Pools – One pool heated seasonally for year-round enjoyment! Professionally Managed – 24/7 service for a seamless stay! Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected during your vacation! General Parking - 2 Passes Provided – Hassle-free parking for guests!Welcome to Beachin' it with the BrownsTake a break from your busy life at this darling, third-floor condo in Santa Rosa Beach! Inside this sparkling and very inviting getaway, you'll find a well-equipped, full kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar for two, a dining nook with a table, chairs, and bench seating, and a sunlit living area with plush furniture and a cable-equipped TV for relaxing nights in. And outside, breathe in the fresh air off the Gulf on your furnished balcony - the perfect spot for morning coffee while you plan out your day using this home's complimentary internet access. You and your guests are also sure to enjoy the on-site, shared pool and tennis courts, while the beach is just a short walk or golf cart trolley ride away. This property offers 6 amenity bands. Note children under 12 will not need a band. Guest will be charged $50.00 to replace any lost bands.*Please note there is ongoing construction behind the property. House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRAGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom: Queen sized bed, private bathroom with tub/shower comboGuest Bedroom 1: Queen sized bed, shared bathroomGuest Bedroom 2: Full over Full bunk bed with twin trundle, shared bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back. Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
